title: The Baker. Full Episode 3.
author: Out_My_Empire
selftext:
Once Upon A Time... The Campaign  
Episode 3 — The Baker

Previously, in Once Upon A Time... The Campaign

It all started when Alessandra Cesare announced her return to the mayoral race.

After two electoral defeats, she had learned an important lesson: ideals alone don't win elections. Abandoning her old rhetoric of systemic reform, she turned her attention to the city's rising kickstarters entrepreneurs and business owners. Her new promise? Local Citizens First. A stronger economy, fewer restrictions, and a city made great again.

But her ambitions didn't go unnoticed.

The Mayor, determined to defend his position, struck back. He reminded the city's entrepreneurs who had opened the doors to opportunity, who had welcomed outside kickstarters investors, and who had made their businesses possible. He called for loyalty and warned them against Alessandra's attempts to turn his supporters into her own political backers.

Now, the real trouble begins.

The Mayor has a problem: he needs results. His entire economic strategy rests on attracting outside investors with tax-free business licenses. And he needs a success story to prove that his gamble is paying off.

Enter the Baker.

His upcoming bakery is supposed to become the Mayor's political trophy: proof that investment is flowing into the city and that his promises are more than campaign slogans.

But the bakery isn't open. The equipment hasn't arrived, money is running short, and the Mayor's patience is wearing thin. Meanwhile, neighboring cities are copying his strategy and competing for the very same investors.

With political pressure mounting, the Baker finds himself caught between powerful people, questionable business offers, and financial arrangements that may cost him far more than he expects.

The Mayor promised the city economic growth.

But will the Baker deliver?

And who, exactly, is going to profit from his success?
